physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio. Written in brown ink. Paper. 12 staves.

annot.p: Contains drafts for thirteen songs without texts, with the numbers 57, 69, 59, 93, 22, 43, 64, 57 (second version), 45, 20, 33, 34, and 64 (second version). "Kammersvenden fra Morland" is No. 93.

physDesc.physMedium: 3 bifolios. Written in brown ink. Paper: 14 staves. First and last page blank. Contains the following songs: "No. 20 Udfrielsen af Ægypten" (HartW 376); "No. 22 Lovgivningen paa Sinai" (HartW 388); "No. 33 David og Goliath" (HartW 391); "No. 34 Davids Seiers-Sang" (HartW 375); "No. 57 Johannes den Døber" (HartW 377); "No. 59 Herrens Fristelse" (HartW 385); "No. 69 Jairi Datter" (HartW 379); "No. 93 Kammersvenden fra Morland"; and "No. 64 Peders Apostel-Kald" (HartW 378). Contrary to Hartmann's habit,the texts are written in Latin script.
